target_customer: AI labs and agent builders needing evaluation and reinforcement learning environments and data for post-training
problem: Evaluating and post-training agents requires many realistic environments and tasks, usually built by hand or by large annotator teams.
business_model: Open source evaluation tooling plus commercial autoscaled RL data and environments (pricing not verified)
product_category: AI evals and RL environments for agents

founders.name: Jithin James
founders.background_notes: YC page: early BentoML employee who built Bentoctl, BentoML and Yatai.

founders.name: Shahul ES
education: Computer science degree, school not named (YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: Kaggle Grandmaster and lead contributor to open source AI projects including Open-Assistant. Founders met in college and collaborated for almost a decade.

technical_complexity.rationale: Autoscaling environments and tasks at the frontier of agent ability draws on open-endedness and environment design research.

defensibility.rationale: The open source Ragas library gives developer reach, but evaluation frameworks and environment vendors are numerous.

market_need_then: LLM application developers needed ways to evaluate RAG pipelines, and later agent labs needed RL environments; the site claims Ragas is used by 80 percent of the Fortune 100 (self reported, unverified).

branding.name_origin: Ragas stands for RAG Assessment per documentation pages; the origin of Vibrant Labs is not stated.
branding.domain_note: Uses vibrantlabs.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Research lab voice: applied research lab for autoscaled RL data

branding.brand_signature: Ragas open source library as the public face of the team
branding.community_and_virality: Ragas is widely listed as a standard RAG evaluation framework in comparison articles.

brand_strength.rationale: The Ragas name is better known than the company name Vibrant Labs, which is generic.

pivots.from: Open source evaluation and testing for LLM applications (Ragas)
pivots.to: Autoscaled evals and RL environments for post-training agents
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from changed YC descriptions, not an announced pivot.

outcome_analysis: Vibrant Labs, listed as Winter 2024 and tied to the Ragas open source project, is active and has shifted its description from LLM app evaluation to RL environments for agents. Funding and exit data are not verified, so no outcome factors are asserted.
notes: The 2.5M pre-seed (around 2025-12, investors undisclosed) rests on a single database (Signalbase) with a jobs aggregator giving the date. Heavybit announced an investment in Vibrant Labs but no amount or round link, so investors are left empty. The link to Ragas comes from the company website and a YC Ragas page listing Vibrant Labs; whether Ragas was a separate YC listing is not resolved. Team size shows 6 on the shard and 2 in a search snippet. Competitor list left empty because TruLens, DeepEval and LangSmith sources found were dated 2026. RagaAI is a different company.
